resources.string: The photos so far stay as they are. The positions start again from the first, with all angles open, and the new photos are kept apart as surroundings %1$d.
The board does not seem to show this position: %1$d squares look different. Compare with the diagram. The photo is kept but not counted.
Without the camera no photos can be taken
Point the camera at the whole board
Hold the phone higher and look down more steeply
Do not look straight down – hold the phone a little lower
Move back a little – the board and its pieces must be in the picture
Good – now move the phone: another angle, distance or side
This position is done – go on to the next

One piece alone, standing on the line, on a plain surface. Hold the phone so far away that the piece just fits into the small frame (about 45 cm). The frame turns green when it shows nothing but the surface.
The photo could not be saved
Measured with a ruler, in millimetres. Needed to put the pieces on the board at their right size.
Diameter of the foot of each kind of piece, measured with a ruler, in millimetres.
Film: %1$d of %2$d – keep moving the phone slowly
This piece is done – go on to the next
The frame must show the surface all the way round: the whole piece inside it, nothing else behind it
Turn the piece a quarter turn, then start the series for side %1$d of %2$d
%1$d photos of %2$s are deleted for good.
There are no photos here to discard
The board was not found in the photo. Try again from a slightly different spot. The photo is kept but not counted.
The phone moved while the photo was taken: it shows the board differently than the live picture did. Hold still until the sound. The photo is kept but not counted.
